verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a public status or health surface, per-service incident history, or post-incident reports. The only related item is a community remark that the status.aws.amazon.com page stays green during outages. That confirms a page exists but does not document per-service history or post-incident reporting, and it suggests the page undercounts outages, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an operations lead, outages are owned in public — a real status/health surface with per-service history and post-incident reports
